facts.text: No magic in the kitchen, dear. We'll make the cake by hand, and it will be beautiful, I think. Merryweather, hold the flour.
facts.why: Not a line from the film. The fairies do try to bake the cake and make the dress by hand before giving in to magic, so it fits Flora as a note.
